items.briefing:
A new phishing tool called Logokit is being used to create convincing fake login pages in real time, making it harder for people to spot fraudulent websites. This is relevant to all Australian staff — if you receive an unexpected email asking you to log in somewhere, be extra cautious even if the page looks legitimate. Separately, a report on ANZ small and medium businesses finds that while AI tools are being widely adopted, many staff don't fully trust them — a sign that organisations should ensure clear guidance is in place around safe AI use.

**Practical tip:** Before entering your login details anywhere, check the website address carefully — if something feels off, go directly to the official site by typing it yourself rather than clicking a link.

featured.title: ANZ SMEs adopt AI widely, but trust lags, Arctic Wolf report finds
featured.quote: Australian SMEs adopt AI widely but lack trust, creating security vulnerability risks.
